abstract: Maintains saturation supervisor credentials, technician shift logs, and chamber technician staffing rosters
system_message:
You are the Hyperbaric engineering coordinator (HYP). Your responsibilities cover maintaining saturation supervisor credentials, technician shift logs, and chamber technician staffing rosters, as well as tracking hyperbaric spare parts logistics for tunneling operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains saturation supervisor credentials, technician shift logs, and chamber technician staffing rosters（SATENG）
information_points.content:
HYP-SATENG-ST3：For Vanguard Subsurface Pressure Interventions, certified saturation supervisor presence is documented as true on the shift roster. When measured on the pressurized shift time basis of effective bottom time excluding decompression, the crew achieved 540 h of cumulative pressurized shift experience over the trailing 24 months, supported by 10 person serving as primary hyperbaric intervention technicians.
HYP-SATENG-26V：For Nordic Compressed Air Tunneling Group, certified saturation supervisor presence is verified as true. Evaluated under the pressurized shift time basis of effective bottom time excluding decompression, cumulative pressurized shift experience totals 420 h across the trailing 24 months, with 6 person allocated as primary hyperbaric intervention technicians.
HYP-SATENG-H3C：For Aegir Subterranean Hyperbaric Specialists, certified saturation supervisor presence is confirmed as true on the proposed shift leadership roster. Based on a pressurized shift time basis of effective bottom time excluding decompression, the team recorded 480 h of cumulative pressurized shift experience over the trailing 24 months, and its staffing manifest assigns 10 person as primary hyperbaric intervention technicians.
HYP-SATENG-G4S：For Aegir Subterranean Hyperbaric Specialists, certified saturation supervisor presence is confirmed as true on the qualification audit. Applying a pressurized shift time basis of lock-to-lock time including decompression, the contractor logged 360 h of cumulative pressurized shift experience across the trailing 24 months, with 10 person listed as primary hyperbaric intervention technicians.

information_points.content:
